$comment: Third-party skills and plugins the framework recommends but does not vendor. Only entries with status 'pinned' are installable; see docs/third-party.md for the review policy.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.purpose: Frontend design, critique, audit, and polish suite
notes: Ships Node scripts and pre-approves Bash(node .claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/*) and Bash(npx impeccable *) in allowed-tools.

Network: version check against impeccable.style that tells the agent to run an unpinned `npx impeccable update`; concept picker sends your choice to impeccable.style/api/chosen; image generation sends prompts to api.openai.com with OPENAI_API_KEY.
Previously installed copy matched no tagged release (updated in place). Install from the pinned ref and decline in-skill update prompts.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
notes: No license or author in the files; cannot be redistributed. 1,206-line SKILL.md (context cost).

skills.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
notes: Superseded by design-taste-frontend; remove unless a project depends on it.

skills.name: gpt-taste
skills.purpose: GSAP motion and AIDA landing-page layout

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.purpose: Generate design images, then implement them
notes: Written for Codex; behavior in Claude Code untested. 1,228-line SKILL.md.

skills.name: stripe-best-practices
skills.purpose: Stripe integration decisions: Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents, Connect, Billing, Tax, webhooks, key handling
notes: Published by Stripe. Previously vendored in src/skills; removed because src/skills holds only framework-owned skills.
Reviewed 2026-10-19: SKILL.md plus six reference files, no allowed-tools, no scripts, no fetch-and-run instructions.

skills.name: upgrade-stripe
skills.purpose: Upgrading Stripe API versions and SDKs (server, Stripe.js, mobile)
notes: Published by Stripe. Previously vendored; removed for the same reason as stripe-best-practices.
Reviewed 2026-10-19: one SKILL.md, no allowed-tools, no scripts. It looks up the current API version on docs.stripe.com and only falls back to its bundled one offline.

skills.name: stripe-projects
skills.purpose: Stripe Projects CLI for provisioning a software stack
notes: Reviewed but not installed by --third-party: it pre-approves Bash(stripe *) and Bash(brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe) in allowed-tools, and provisioning a stack overlaps greenfield-build. Optional.
Install by hand if a project wants it: copy providers/claude/plugin/skills/stripe-projects from the pinned ref into .claude/skills/stripe-projects with the repo's LICENSE.

plugins.purpose: Anthropic's skill authoring and eval tooling (create, test, benchmark skills). For maintaining skills, not for building products; previously vendored in src/skills without a LICENSE.
